BELLKEEPER-BELLKEEPER.title: The Bellkeeper
BELLKEEPER-BELLKEEPER.description: A blind porter carrying the last cracked brass bell from a collapsed belfry, climbing the Spire to return it to its maker.
BELLKEEPER-BELLKEEPER.goldMonologue: Every coin that drops into the pouch leaves an echo the bronze remembers.
BELLKEEPER-BELLKEEPER.eventDeathPreventi: Cannot fall here... the last bell has not yet reached the top.
BELLKEEPER-BELLKEEPER.aromaPrinciple: Warm brass, cold tallow smoke, and the sharp tang of ancient verdigris.
BELLKEEPER-BELLKEEPER.cardsModifierDescr: Bellkeeper cards may appear in rewards and shops.
BELLKEEPER-BELLKEEPER.banter.dead.endTur: ...(only a faint, dying hum of brass)
